title: Placed Consumer Accounts Worksheet: Portal Credit-Card Ceiling of the Day
content:
Payment Operations worksheet for **Placed Consumer Accounts**, setting out the portal credit-card ceiling of the day.

## Definition

The portal credit-card ceiling of the day is the smallest of its rounded figure, the stage's single card-payment maximum and the balance due, and it is never below zero, where:

1. **the rounded figure** is the stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum less the credit-card payments received on the account in the last month, rounded to the cent (a half cent going to the even cent), once, on the finished figure and never on an intermediate amount;
2. **the balance due** for the portal credit-card ceiling is the placed balance plus supplemental additions, returned payments and refunded overpayments, less consumer payments, direct payments, client credits and settlement waivers, as booked when the consumer opens the portal for the credit-card payment;
3. **the last N months**: for the portal credit-card ceiling, a payment, a return, a dispute, a verification mailing or a supplemental addition falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month.

The stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum and single card-payment maximum are the figures of the Placed Consumer Accounts payment schedule for the account's stage.

## Worksheet lines (hypothetical)

*Every amount is invented, the two stage figures included. Handling date 2026-10-10.*

| Line | Entry | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| A | Stage rolling 30-day card-payment maximum | $10000.00 |
| B | Credit-card payments received in the last month: $750.00 on 2026-09-25 and $250.00 on 2026-10-06 (a third, of $400.00 on 2026-09-08, is more than a whole month back) | $1000.00 |
| C | A less B, rounded to the cent | $9000.00 |
| D | Stage single card-payment maximum | $5000.00 |
| E | Balance due as booked when the portal is opened | $3612.45 |
| F | Smallest of C, D and E, not below zero | **$3612.45** |

## Boundary readings

- On a handling date of 2026-10-10 a credit-card payment of 2026-09-11 is in the last month and one of 2026-09-10 is not.
- If line B exceeded line A, line C would be negative and the ceiling would be zero.
- If the balance due were $6200.00 on the same lines, the ceiling would be the stage maximum on line D, $5000.00.
